applicableAreas: All buildings within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities

agentTrace.reasoning: UCM § 1.10.3 requires surveyed elevations of overhead conductors on building elevation sheets. Their absence is a deficiency regardless of whether clearances are actually adequate.
